name: Type poster
idea: Type is the picture: giant condensed words cropped by the edge, blocks of colour.
brief: A typographic poster. Few words, set enormous in the condensed display face; a key word may run off the edge of the slide and be cropped (keep it legible). Split the slide into one or two flat colour blocks (--c-accent and --c-ground, or --c-surface) with hard edges. Stack lines tightly at var(--lh-display). Small text is only a caption in the label face, tucked in a corner on the grid. Every slide should read from across a room.
never: small type as the main element
bullet lists of more than three

styles: high-contrast graphic black and white photography, strong shadows
